Charts
Animated data visualizations with spring motion.
NEW
Treemap NEW Proportional tiles that morph with your data, with value and share tooltips.
Candlestick Chart NEW OHLC candles with a live last price and volume, inspectable by keyboard.
Donut Chart NEW Round-capped ring with a live center, legend, and sweep-in motion.
Volume Profile NEW Horizontal volume-by-price with POC and a value-area highlight.
Status Bar NEW Proportional incident bar with operational, degraded, and outage segments.
Composition Chart NEW 100% stacked bar or area composition across periods.
Funnel Chart NEW Conversion funnel with curved morphs, drop-off, and stage buttons.
Liquidity Heatmap NEW Order-book liquidity bands over time with a price trace.
Bump Chart NEW Ranking bump chart with curved series that break on missing periods.
Order Book NEW Live bid/ask depth tables, spread, and a balance bar.
Heat Calendar NEW GitHub-style contribution heatmap with range selection and legend filter.
Returns Calendar NEW Monthly returns grid with gain/loss tint and compounded span totals.
Price Target Fan NEW High/mean/low price-target fan over a history path with a cursor.
